View in Mac App Store 1 RATING 5.0 AGE RATING 18+ Years CATEGORY Food & Drink DEVELOPER FSC Franchise Co LANGUAGE EN English SIZE 13.1 MB iPhone, iPad Brass Tap Loyalty Rewards App. Browse thousands of beers and discover new ones that match your preferred brew characteristics. The Brass Tap App. Browse thousands of beers and discover new ones that match your preferred brew characteristics – including style, ABV, color, clarity, origin and brewery. Set your favorite Brass Tap to create the ultimate shortcut to your Tap’s specific menus, events and specials. You can even start a “Beer Diary” rating and ranking every brew to keep track of all your favs. Tap into your Brew Crew account to check your status and view any rewards you’ve acquired and the beers you’ve tried. Out on the town and planning your next stop? Use the app to find your closest Brass Tap. Download the new Brass Tap app now and see just how rewarding it can be. more Ratings & Reviews 5.0 out of 5 1 Ratings Great App for a Great Concept 06/28/2013 Jwalkermobile Excellent features, allows you to select your favorite Brass Tap, shows the beers available, and will even alert you when they tap a new beer! Just doesn’t work 12/07/2019 KevinSedota New update:The main problem is the app does NOT tell you if you’ve made a mistake when logging in. If you enter an invalid brew crew id or email it just loads the app and tells you you have no beers. Apps need to tell the user if they have entered invalid ids otherwise it just looks like you have no data.It would also be nice the be able to associate an email with a brew crew id. I can currently only log in with the brew crew id which I don’t always have at hand. The older version used to keep track of which beers you tried. This is important since you earn points for trying each different brew so you want to try as many different things as possible. The new version just does’t show anything. You get a list of all beers and i guess in theory it should show you if you’ve tried it but there are two problems.1. It shows all beers they have ever offered. I guess you’re supposed to look through the list then check if you’ve tried it. This is way too long a list for this to be practical.2. It does NOT show if you’ve tried it. more Developer Response Updated response: Thank you again for your feedback. Brew Crew IDs are being phased out in favor of email addresses. When logging in by email, you will always be told if the email you are trying to use is not registered. We hope this will improve your experience in the future. Thank you for your patience through this transitory period. Original response: Thanks for your feedback! You need to log into your Brew Crew account within the app in order to see your beer history and reward points. If you are unable to log in, or if your history or points are not accurate, please contact your local Brass Tap so that we can assist you. more Major changes needed 06/20/2016 ashen saint As one review stated, it would be great to use the app itself as a means of checking in rather than the card itself. Recently I've also noticed that when I check beers I've tried, it lists ALL of their beers. And when I look at new beers...nothing is listed. It would be quite a task, but finding a way to see what beers are available at your local brass tap and then ticking them off for flights or saving them so you can order more quickly when you arrive would be helpful too. As of right now, the app is just a glorified version of the web based app. more Developer Response Thanks for your feedback! I don't know that we've been able to hit all the items on your wish list, but we have just released a new and upgraded version of the app that has fixed a number of past issues and added some additional new features. Maybe give it a try and see how we're coming along? more Great Start to an App with Lots of Potential 09/15/2013 RMH4HOTH A nice start to this app, with the huge list of beers offered, location locator, and upcoming events/live entertainment schedules. This app has a lot of potential, such as adding your Brew Crew membership card & info (points earned, the list of beers sampled...it would save paper!)...even a link to a bank card to pay your tab?) Keep working on it! What’s New Minor technical updates.
